Effective hair regrowth depends on `identifying the underlying cause of thinning` , such as hereditary pattern baldness, stress, or nutritional deficiencies.[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[2]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)

### Proven Medical Treatments

- **Minoxidil (Rogaine):** An FDA-approved topical foam or liquid (and prescription pill) that enlarges hair follicles and lengthens the growth phase. It takes at least 3 to 6 months of daily use to see results, and use must continue to maintain benefits.
- **Finasteride (Propecia):** A daily oral prescription pill that blocks DHT (dihydrotestosterone) to stop pattern hair loss in men.
- **Prescription Antiandrogens:** Medications like spironolactone are used for female-pattern hair loss.
- **JAK Inhibitors:** Targeted drugs like baricitinib (Olumiant) or ritlecitinib (Litfulo) treat severe alopecia areata.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)[[2]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[3]](https://www.vcuhealth.org/news/a-dermatologists-guide-to-hair-loss-treatments/)[[4]](https://www.health.com/beauty/how-to-regrow-hair)[[5]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/treatments/8307-hair-loss-treatments)[[6]](https://nyulangone.org/conditions/hair-loss/treatments/medication-for-hair-loss)

### Natural and Supportive Approaches

- **Rosemary Oil:** Clinical comparisons show that topical rosemary oil performs similarly to dilute minoxidil in promoting hair count over six months.
- **Scalp Massage:** Performing a daily 4-minute scalp massage can stretch skin cells and encourage thicker hair density over 24 weeks.
- **Targeted Nutrition:** Correcting deficiencies in protein, iron, or vitamin D supports the hair growth cycle.[[1]](https://www.uhhospitals.org/blog/articles/2025/11/hair-growth-products-do-they-work)[[2]](https://www.verywellhealth.com/home-remedies-for-hair-growth-8599227)

Learn more about clinical options via the [Mayo Clinic Hair Loss Guide](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932) or explore dermatologist-reviewed regimens at [Harvard Health Publishing](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair).[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20372932)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)If you'd like to narrow this down, tell me:

- Are you noticing hair loss **gradually (pattern thinning)** or **suddenly (shedding/patches)**?
- Are you looking for **over-the-counter** or **prescription** options?
